g.text: CampusClaw Target Database Interrupt - Application Boundaries
No remote Agent or public ID.
No slow cancellation in this loop.
Same terminal enqueued at most once;
Do not take business execution permits.
Keep separate control and DB budgets.
Bound both target groups and actual waiters.
Each response owns its receipt and queue.
Coordinate last removal with new registration.
never delete durable stop or terminal records.
